mapper.insert: insert into accounts (role, username, phone, password_hash, region_code, avatar_url, intro, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{role}, #{username}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{regionCode}, #{avatarUrl}, #{intro}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select id, role, username, phone, password_hash, region_code, avatar_url, intro, status, created_at, updated_at from accounts
select exists(select 1 from accounts where phone = #{phone})
select exists(select 1 from accounts where username = #{username})
